SELECT DISTINCT UOC.PARENT_ROLE_CODE AS UO_MAIN_CODE, UO.EXTERNAL_ID AS UO_OTHER_CODE, UO.PARTY_NAME AS UO_NAME, UO.PARTY_NAME_LANG AS UO_NAME_LANG, UO.PARTY_ID AS UO_ID, RT.DESCRIPTION AS ROLE_NAME, RT.DESCRIPTION_LANG AS ROLE_NAME_LANG, RT.ROLE_TYPE_ID AS ROLE_TYPE_ID, RES.PARTY_ID AS RESP_ID, RES.PARTY_NAME AS RESP_NAME FROM PARTY UO INNER JOIN PARTY_PARENT_ROLE UOC ON UOC.PARTY_ID = UO.PARTY_ID AND UOC.ROLE_TYPE_ID = 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT' INNER JOIN PARTY_ROLE PR ON PR.PARTY_ID = UO.PARTY_ID INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET ON (WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID IS NULL AND WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID2 IS NULL AND WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID3 IS NULL) OR PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID IN (WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID, WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID2, WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID3) INNER JOIN ROLE_TYPE RT ON RT.ROLE_TYPE_ID = PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID and RT.role_type_id <> 'INTERNAL_ORGANIZATIO' LEFT JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP UORES ON UORES.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_RESPONSIBLE' AND UORES.PARTY_ID_FROM = UO.PARTY_ID AND UORES.FROM_DATE <= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND (UORES.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR UORES.THRU_DATE >= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) LEFT JOIN PARTY RES ON RES.PARTY_ID = UORES.PARTY_ID_TO LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP ORGRD ON ORGRD.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID IN ('ORG_RESPONSIBLE', 'ORG_DELEGATE') AND ORGRD.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID AND ORGRD.PARTY_ID_FROM = PR.PARTY_ID AND ORGRD.PARTY_ID_TO = UO.PARTY_ID AND ORGRD.FROM_DATE <= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND (ORGRD.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR ORGRD.THRU_DATE >= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP SUPORG ON SUPORG.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'GROUP_ROLLUP' AND SUPORG.ROLE_TYPE_ID_TO = PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID AND SUPORG.PARTY_ID_TO = PR.PARTY_ID AND SUPORG.FROM_DATE <= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND (SUPORG.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR SUPORG.THRU_DATE >= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP SUPRD ON SUPRD.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID IN ('ORG_RESPONSIBLE', 'ORG_DELEGATE') AND SUPRD.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = SUPORG.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND SUPRD.PARTY_ID_FROM = SUPORG.PARTY_ID_FROM AND SUPRD.PARTY_ID_TO = UO.PARTY_ID AND SUPRD.FROM_DATE <= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND (SUPRD.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR SUPRD.THRU_DATE >= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP TOPSUP ON TOPSUP.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'GROUP_ROLLUP' AND TOPSUP.ROLE_TYPE_ID_TO = SUPORG.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND TOPSUP.PARTY_ID_TO = SUPORG.PARTY_ID_FROM AND TOPSUP.FROM_DATE <= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND (TOPSUP.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR TOPSUP.THRU_DATE >= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP TOPRD ON TOPRD.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID IN ('ORG_RESPONSIBLE', 'ORG_DELEGATE') AND TOPRD.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = TOPSUP.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND TOPRD.PARTY_ID_FROM = TOPSUP.PARTY_ID_FROM AND TOPRD.PARTY_ID_TO = UO.PARTY_ID AND TOPRD.FROM_DATE <= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND (TOPRD.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR TOPRD.THRU_DATE >= #{refDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) WHERE UOC.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organizationId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (
(ORGRD.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL AND (ORGRD.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR ORGRD.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(WET.PARENT_TYPE_ID,'%'))))
OR
(SUPRD.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL AND (SUPRD.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR SUPRD.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(WET.PARENT_TYPE_ID,'%'))))
OR
(TOPRD.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL AND (TOPRD.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR TOPRD.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(WET.PARENT_TYPE_ID,'%'))))
)
ORDER BY
UOC.PARENT_ROLE_CODE
UO.EXTERNAL_ID
UO.PARTY_NAME_LANGUO.PARTY_NAME
